claim: Do not edit the tree while a selftest or compare runs: the stamp hashes the tree at start, and a half-edited layout gave a false slowdown.

evidence.text: A selftest's stamp hashes the tree at its start, so no edits while it runs (full verify about 45 min detached).
A half-edited layout gave a false slowdown on levels 2-8, cleared by a worktree bisect.
